trainers.instruction: Read the text and answer the question.

atoms.text: Maya and Jamie both want to make their school’s hockey team. Jamie has thought of steps he needs to take to get there. Maya has done the same but has also made a written action plan including specific steps.

atoms.a: Who do you think will have an easier time reaching their goal?

trainers.instruction: What do you think Maya included in her hockey action plan? Sort the options.

atoms.b: reasons why she wants to reach the goal
steps she can take to reach her goal
a date by which she wants to achieve her goal
how to join the rounders team

atoms.a: Writing down the steps you need to take to reach a goal will confuse you.

feedback.wrong: Writing down the steps you have thought of can help you remember them and make it clear in which order you need to take them.

atoms.a: Keeping track of your progress in an action plan can help you stay motivated.

feedback.wrong: Tracking the steps you have taken visualises what you have already achieved and can make the goal seem less overwhelming.

atoms.a: The action plan should be very general and should have lots of different things you want to do.

feedback.wrong: An action plan should be as specific as possible and reflect your goal. Think of SMART goals and try to include all aspects in your written plan.

trainers.instruction: How can you include the aspects of SMART goals in an action plan? Match the items.

text: Remember, these are all the aspects of a SMART goal:
hint.sound: Remember, these are all the aspects of a SMART goal: it is specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-limited.

atoms.b: only write down steps that are related to your goal
include a tracker for your progress
write down smaller steps you need to take

trainers.instruction: How can you include the aspects of SMART goals in an action plan? Match the items.

text: Remember, these are all the aspects of a SMART goal:
hint.sound: Remember, these are all the aspects of a SMART goal: it is specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-limited.

atoms.b: include a start and end date
write down reasons why you want to achieve the goal

trainers.instruction: Take a look at the action plan and decide which goal fits it best.

b: ++I want to save money for a new bike by doing chores around the house.
I want to save money for a new phone by doing chores around the house.
I want to save money for a new bike by not spending any of my pocket money.
++I want to get better at drawing animals in the next three months.
I want to get better at drawing animals in the next two years.
I want to get better at drawing flowers in the next month.
